title: Register on Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation and Epilepsy Surgery
summary: The EpiC Register examines how presurgical epilepsy diagnostics and epilepsy surgery are carried out in German-speaking countries. All patients undergoing presurgical epilepsy evaluation and/or epilepsy surgery at the participating centers can participate. The results of the study should contribute to (a) enabling people with difficult-to-treat epilepsy to receive a pre-surgical diagnosis at an earlier stage and (b) optimizing the actual diagnostic process.

interventions.name: Presurgical epilepsy evaluation and/or epilepsy surgery: Patients are interviewed pre- and postoperatively through questionnaires about their medical history and their personal opinions.
